entities.name: Mónica Bardem
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mónica María Encinas Bardem is a Spanish film actress, daughter of actress Pilar Bardem and sister of actors Carlos and Javier Bardem. Some of her films are Kika (1993), Más que amor, frenesí (1996) and Boca a boca (1995). She also manages the family restaurants La Bardemcilla and La Bardemcilla de Santa Ana in Madrid, but it was closed due to economic problems in 2013.
